paper_metadata.title: A 6.5-GHz Energy-Efficient BFSK Modulator for Wireless Sensor Applications
paper_metadata.abstract: A 6.5-GHz FSK modulator suitable for low power wireless sensor network is presented. The energy efficient modulator employs closed-loop direct VCO modulation to achieve high data rate, multistage variable loop bandwidth technique for fast startup time and - for reduced power consumption in the synthesizer with fine resolution in frequency channel selection. The modulator, implemented using 0.25m CMOS, achieves 20s startup time with an effective data rate of 2.5 Mb/s while consuming 22 mW.
